title: Keep an AI suggestion separate from evidence and permission
summary: Preserve the source and unresolved details when a model proposes an action.
objectives: Distinguish a proposed action from a human decision or execution grant.

sources.title: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
sources.basis: Risk management and evaluation require context and evidence. This lesson does not claim conformity assessment or certify an AI system.

sections.title: Retain what the source actually says
paragraphs: A fictional message requests a review by Friday. Without a timezone and calendar date, keep the deadline unresolved. Retain a reference to the synthetic source rather than inventing a timestamp.
A summary, category or next action proposed by a model is still a proposal. A plausible answer does not become an observed fact.

sections.title: Make the next boundary explicit
paragraphs: The exercise retains kind=ai-suggestion and deadline=null and provides no execution grant. It cannot send a reply or fetch an attachment.
Before sending data to a model, review the destination, purpose, retention and authority. Minimize message logging and keep suggestions separate from execution permissions.

exercise.instruction: Run the synthetic interpretation example and inspect the unresolved deadline and missing grant.
exercise.expected: The proposal remains an AI suggestion with no deadline and no execution authority.

limitations: No model is called; no classifier, autonomous agent or decision engine is accepted by this example.
Business records and decision reviews require separate ownership and access policies.
